data.content:
## [Delivery Service is not responsive](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a85e455da9a8014cfb0d4b6)
Delivery Service is not responsive. I received an email and text asking me to confirm my availability for a delivery today, 8/19/26 between noon and 3:00 p.m. I replied that didn't work. I received a reply back noting they were sorry it didn't work and that a member of their team would contact me to discuss my preferred scheduled. I did not hear back and so I contacted them on Monday, 8/17/26 and explained I wouldn't be home until 1:00 p.m. and that I could be home from that time on. I spoke with a woman who put me on hold several times to confer with dispatch. She indicated the time could be before 1:00 and I clarified that no, it would need be from 1:00 p.m. throughout the rest of the day. I was put on hold again and she came back and said they could make my delivery toward the end of their route after 1:00 p.m. Today, I received a call at 11:30 a.m. indicating they would be at my home in 15 minutes and I explained that I would not be home until 1:00. Then another person called me and told me I would have to be scheduled for next week because the delivery team was leaving my area. I explained that I never received a call to discuss my scedule prior to today and so I had taken the initiative to reach out to the company on Monday. Then, when I asked which day next week, I was told they are only in my area one day per week and they didn't know which day that would be yet. The person was very apologetic, however didn't seem to have any power to make this right. This is very disappointing, especially with a $199 delivery fee. I feel you need to examine your delivery vendors to be responsive and to be customer oriented. I have no idea when the table will be delivered. I'd appreciate it if you would consider reimbursing me for the delivery fee since the process is not effective.

August 4, 2026
